trigger: U09 critique and verification (wave 3): renders at 3 widths (480/700/1000) passed the height check while 560-580 pt grew +20 pt and pills hyphenated at 600 pt.
lesson: Layout acceptance checks sampled at a few widths miss bad bands between ViewThatFits tiers.
how_to_apply: Require before/after renders as a sweep (e.g. every 20 pt across the supported width range, both backgrounds) and a check that reads every pair present.
